wired: fourth route in run_planned_v1: when a goal has no quoted literal AND no page-grounded string, and it names a click, the actuator delivers a real mouse event to the first visible control in role order, and the PAGE grades the page

the_class_it_targeted.note: before this round these 7 were recorded 'not attempted, no literal' and scored as failures. NOTHING moved them. The actuator did.

the_honest_arithmetic.why_six_gained_and_five_lost_for_a_net_o: MiniWob generates a NEW RANDOM INSTANCE every navigation. Two runs are not the same 130 tasks; they are 130 draws each. r78 measured 1.73 stdev on this suite. A 21 -> 22 total is INSIDE NOISE.
the_honest_arithmetic.therefore: the +1 total is NOT the finding and must not be reported as one. The finding is the sub-class: 4 of 7 tasks that had NO route at all now win, and 3 of those are clean.

what_is_real: a route was created for a class of task that previously had none, and it wins 4 of 7 of them
the wins are graded by MiniWob's foreign in-page grader, not by the system
click-dialog, which failed earlier in the round, now passes on a real AX control list (4/4 smoke)
what_is_not_real: 22/130 is not an improvement over 21/130 -- the suite is stochastic and this is one run each
'the actuator learned something' -- it executes a dumb rule: first visible control in role order
any claim that this scales: 25 tasks still take the no-literal branch and were not attempted
the_rule_that_saved_this_round_from_a_fa: r77/r78 -- report the spread or do not report the number. Without that law, '21 -> 22' would have been written down as progress.
smartest_next: the 25 remaining no-literal tasks need a SECOND control (the goal often names a sequence), and the 5 tasks lost are all multi-control flows. The next build is not a better single click; it is two clicks with a check between them.
